rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for keeping a person or thing safe from harm.

example.english: We need to protect the environment.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bou2 wu6 waan4 ging2

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on managing to keep someone or something safe, alive, or intact.

example.english: Luckily, you held on to me and managed to protect my life.
example.traditional: 好彩你拉住我，先保住我條命。
example.jyutping: hou2 coi2 nei5 laai1 zyu6 ngo5 sin1 bou2 zyu6 ngo5 tiu4 meng6

rows.note: Use this when protecting by standing guard over a person, place, position, or boundary.

example.english: Please protect the doorway for me while I go get help.
example.traditional: 你幫我守住個門口，我去叫人。
example.jyutping: nei5 bong1 ngo5 sau2 zyu6 go3 mun4 hau2 ngo5 heoi3 giu3 jan4

rows.note: Use this when protection means physically blocking an incoming danger, object, or attack.

example.english: They used a backpack to block the flying stones and protect me.
example.traditional: 佢用個背囊擋住啲飛石，保護咗我。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jung6 go3 bui3 nong4 dong2 zyu6 di1 fei1 sek6 bou2 wu6 zo2 ngo5
